plan.purpose: High-concurrency round 5 (best effort). Occupancy/SM-cost plane at D = 256: TileLang grid CTAs with batch tiles 32/64 and one or two warpgroups (the two-warpgroup kind moved D = 768 in round 3). Qualified at the M0 + M6 standard plus bitwise equality with the reference kernel; split-0 selection among all qualified D = 256 configurations; split-1 paired timing of the best against s0p_default, against the round-1 best and against s0 at C = 1024
plan.stop_criterion: at C = 1024 for D = 256 and D = 768, LSTM and sLSTM: throughput >= 2x max(s0, s0p) and P90 no worse than s0
plan.node_reason: One ACC node (4 H100): qualification lanes in parallel, then selection and paired timing per lane
not_claimed: arrival processes other than a closed batch
